title:
Epic that listens for `VALUE_SET` actions under the "To Do Alerts" date range selector, and does the following:
  - Calculates the start filtering date using `now() - selectedPeriod` using {@link ReliabilityTransformUtil#dateMinusPeriod}.
  - Stores the calculated UTC date in {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#alertFilteringStartDate} as `string`.
  - Stores a string serialization of the selected {@link Period} in
    {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#alertFilteringStartDatePeriod}.

Payload should be an object with the following properties:

- `stateId`: Application State Id
- `timeFrameSelectorId`: UI TimeFrame Dropdown Selector Id, ex: `Reliability.ToDoAlertsTopContentFrameDateRangeFilter`
- `defaultPeriod`: (Optional) In case `timeFrameSelectorId` has no value, the epic will use this period as default.

**NOTE:** The date is always set to local midnight.
name: ToDoAlertsDateRangeSelectorEpic
